prompts.name: 张角
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transform the supplied game character/style references into ONE polished landscape 3:2 Chinese 2D game BOSS SKILL DESIGN BOARD for 桃园小英雄. This is a concept sheet, not a screenshot or production sprite sheet.
Reference 1 is the existing 14-boss identity atlas: preserve ONLY the specifically named boss's face, costume, proportions and distinctive weapon. Reference 2 is the mounted-character atlas; use its FIRST rider and red horse only for 吕布, otherwise ignore it. Reference 3 is the approved 金锋回旋 effect board: match its warm brown ink outlines, bold flat hand-painted shapes, simple grassy battlefield, chunky tiny-foot chibi anatomy, readable solid thick VFX and playful tone. Do not copy Liu Bei as the boss.
LAYOUT: consistent jade-green and pale-gold frame; a clean top title; 3 rows for 3 skills, 3 columns labelled exactly “蓄势” “释放” “命中”. Each cell is a separate small grassy tactical battle view, same zoom and consistent boss identity. Add each skill's Chinese name as its row label. Small green-robed Liu Bei with bun and straw shoes is the DODGING TARGET, always smaller than the boss. Boss casts; green Liu Bei does not cast boss skills. Make stages truly different, including boss body/arms/weapon action, solid main effect, and actual contact at correct targets. Keep faces readable and give a visible safe route. Pale readable ground warnings are only secondary; MAIN effects must be physical blades, projectiles, creatures or solid magical bodies, never just coloured fan/cone/rectangle outlines. Clearly separate windup, dramatic brief peak, and localized impact/debris. Avoid giant full-screen glows, 3D realistic rendering, long-legged adults, HUD, QR code, excessive explanatory text, photorealistic ground, watermarks. Bottom small text exactly “概念设计 · 未实装”. This board must look like one coherent set of implementable game effects, not a cinematic fantasy poster.
TITLE EXACT: 张角 · 黄天雷法
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 TOP ROW FIRST figure: yellow Taoist cap with black-white taiji jewel, bushy short dark beard, laughing thick-browed face, yellow/orange robe and lightning-topped staff.
ROW 1, exact label “黄符定雷”: Windup: Zhang Jiao raises lightning staff; yellow-red talismans gather toward a single locked ground seal beside small Liu Bei. Release: one thick gold-white branching lightning bolt hits that exact seal; layered hot core, golden body, orange edge. Impact: a small blazing ground star, scattered talisman scraps and branching residual ground electricity; Liu Bei steps outside the zone.
ROW 2, exact label “三才雷阵”: Windup: three separate clearly spaced talisman seals with a safe gap. Release: staggered three gold lightning strikes, different timing rather than simultaneous screen fill. Impact: three small local crack/spark bursts, spent paper fluttering; safe path still obvious.
ROW 3, exact label “太平雷狱”: Windup: three solid upright floating yellow talisman stakes, each with red calligraphic strokes. Release: ONE thick irregular lightning chain connects two stakes; other two edges remain inactive so triangle is NOT sealed. Impact: one stake breaks under a straw-shoe hit and its adjacent lightning dissolves into golden sparks.

TITLE EXACT: 吕布 · 赤兔重骑
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 TOP ROW SECOND figure and Reference2 TOP LEFT rider: mischievous thick eyebrows, black hair, two long RED pheasant plumes, gold-red armour, red cape, crescent halberd. Must ride the same chunky red-brown 赤兔 horse with gold bridle.
ROW 1, exact label “赤兔破军”: Windup: mounted Lü Bu crouches and levels halberd, horse paws earth and visibly points its head toward target. Release: a fast straight charge with a thick solid dark-red/gold halberd wedge, blown-back cape and sequential hoof dust. Impact: localized contact spark and displaced grass near a dodging Liu Bei; horse brakes with a heavy low dust wave. No glowing rectangular lane.
ROW 2, exact label “画戟回旋”: Windup: Lü Bu visibly twists torso and raises halberd while pulling horse reins. Release: a sweeping SOLID crescent halberd blade, dark-red back rim, orange-gold body and warm-white sharp edge, tapered ends and two separated short trails like approved sweep quality. Impact: metal sparks where the actual halberd passes, horse plants feet; leave room to retreat.
ROW 3, exact label “无双三连冲”: Windup: sharp reining-in before another dash. Release: ONE fully solid active mounted Lü Bu rushing along a newly locked direction, with TWO very faint earlier-position afterimages and fading hoof dust showing a three-beat sequence, never three living Lü Bu copies. Impact: dramatic third stop, red plumes swinging forward, gold halberd flare and outward earth chips.

TITLE EXACT: 董卓 · 重装暴君
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 TOP ROW THIRD figure: very plump laughing bearded warlord, gold crown, rich purple-gold robe/armour, chunky gold club and food-skewer comic attitude. Preserve round body and small feet, not a muscular fighter.
ROW 1, exact label “金印镇地”: Windup: Dong Zhuo heaves a thick gigantic gold imperial seal overhead, its readable shadow shrinks at the locked landing point. Release: the seal slams into grass with a white-hot contact core and low thick gold impact skirt. Impact: broken earth plates, short dirt chunks and momentary squash of the seal; no flat circle-only explosion.
ROW 2, exact label “赤铜横财”: Windup: Dong Zhuo tips a heavy purse; a few huge thick square-hole copper coins stand on edge. Release: coins roll in staggered separate lanes, red-hot rims, visible thickness and wobble, short dark-red ember tails. Impact: one coin skips and strikes earth with chips. Coins must be much larger and more dangerous-looking than collectible currency; leave gaps.
ROW 3, exact label “酒池焚阵”: Windup: Dong Zhuo throws three small ceramic wine jars on obvious arcs. Release: jars shatter into pieces and splash wine into three separate irregular puddles, with one igniting first. Impact: staggered thick curling orange/gold flames with dark-red bases, ceramic shards and quickly fading scorch marks, clear passage between pools.

TITLE EXACT: 袁绍 · 军阵统帅
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 TOP ROW FIFTH figure (NOT the fourth emperor with green seal): ornate gold helmet with large RED crest, short moustache/goatee, long purple robe and gold armour, smug half-closed eyes, ceremonial fan/command banner.
ROW 1, exact label “四世箭阵”: Windup: Yuan Shao raises an ornate command flag; a short line of 4 small gold-armoured archers bends bows, all aiming the same way. Release: a layered volley of actual wooden red-feather arrows with thick arrowheads and a clearly visible gap in the formation. Impact: one cart is damaged and breaks into wheel/wood fragments near a straw-shoe hit, opening a safe side.
ROW 3, exact label “万军齐射”: Windup: Yuan Shao plants flag and two separated archer ranks prepare in different directions. Release: three-beat staggered arrow walls with a broad moving safe opening, clearly shaped physical arrow clusters rather than filled fan outlines. Impact: planted arrows and small synchronized dust bursts while the safe opening stays readable.

TITLE EXACT: 曹操 · 倚天疑兵

ROW 1, exact label “倚天连刃”: Windup: Cao Cao draws his sword sideways and twists shoulder; small silver-blue energy clings to actual blade. Release: TWO staggered thick silver crescent sword projectiles with ink-blue backs and discontinuous short tails, visibly airborne above grass. Release: TWO tiger/leopard-armoured cavalry make staggered straight charges with distinct hoof dust while Cao Cao holds his sword for a delayed blade attack; always a visible escape gap. Impact: first rider brakes as the actual silver sword wave arrives later, no simultaneous closed ring.

TITLE EXACT: 孟获 · 百兽蛮王
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 SECOND ROW SIXTH figure: stocky dark-bearded tan warlord, green leaf crown/leaf skirt, animal-tooth necklace, gold-studded heavy club, very expressive broad face. Add a compact tribal war drum for summoning but keep his existing identity.
ROW 1, exact label “猪突猛进”: Windup: Meng Huo pounds drum as THREE or FOUR chunky tusked boars lower heads and scratch earth. Release: boars genuinely sprint in a broad straight formation, fore/hind legs in different running phases, tusks and ears bouncing, thick hoof dust and flying grass. Impact: one boar is knocked aside at a real straw-shoe contact, leaving a gap in the charging group. No ordinary pink healing pigs.

Release: two wolves follow curved approach routes before one launches a straight locked pounce, limbs stretched, airborne shadow below. Impact: landing dirt and small claw-contact sparks; green Liu Bei has moved out of the final pounce spot. Must look distinct from boars, not recoloured same animals.
ROW 3, exact label “万象开道”: Windup: TWO rounded small war elephants in tribal cloth armour lift trunks and fan ears while Meng Huo beats drum. Release: elephants cross at staggered timings with heavy alternating planted feet, one front leg compressing into earth, low dense foot dust, broad clear passage between them. Impact: huge weight conveyed through earth chips and tiny local shake marks, one elephant brakes; cute game-scale elephants, never enormous realistic animals obscuring the player.

TITLE EXACT: 司马懿 · 棋阵星劫
BOSS IDENTITY: Reference1 SECOND ROW SEVENTH/rightmost figure: elderly sharp-eyed white-bearded strategist, tall dark-purple hood/cap, layered dark-purple robe and jade-green robe edge, long white eyebrows and sly smile. Preserve tiny feet and large head.
ROW 1, exact label “落子成灾”: Windup: Sima Yi raises fingers; THREE thick black/white Go stones hover over separately lit grass-grid intersections with small landing shadows. Release: one heavy glossy stone drops while the next is still above; solid impact and short ink-like ground cracks. Impact: bouncing stone chips, brief purple-white rune glint and low dust, clear empty grid squares.
ROW 2, exact label “阴阳双龙”: Windup: Sima Yi turns two opposite black-white rune stones; paired dragon heads start condensing. Release: TWO readable solid chibi magical dragons with heads, segmented curved bodies, whiskers and tails glide across in separate arcs, black dragon outlined moon-white, white dragon edged indigo-purple. A broad safe corridor runs between them. Impact: dragon tails unravel into controlled ink/pale sparks at separate endpoints; never two plain rings or a fullscreen white mist.

Release: THREE staggered purple-gold rocky meteors with substantial cores and tapered flame tails fall into only selected cells, leaving adjacent safe squares. Impact: thick low impact skirts, tossed Go stones, short ground fractures and fading fragments, hero face clearly visible; no all-screen chessboard wipe.
